name: liquefy-ui
title: liquefy-ui base
description: Design tokens, the glass stylesheet and the Tailwind v4 bridge. Every other item depends on this. Import the installed stylesheet before Tailwind so utilities win over component styles.

name: glass-card
title: GlassCard
description: A content card with eyebrow, title, description, body and footer slots on the liquid surface.

name: glass-dock
title: GlassDock
description: A macOS-style dock: a glass rail of icon buttons that magnify under the pointer.

name: liquid-accordion
title: LiquidAccordion
description: Stacked disclosure panels with real headings and a height-measured open animation.

name: liquid-alert
title: LiquidAlert
description: An inline status message in four severities, with an optional dismiss button.

name: liquid-avatar
title: LiquidAvatar
description: A circular avatar with image, initials and status dot, plus an overlapping group.

name: liquid-badge
title: LiquidBadge
description: A small count or status pill for hanging off icons and labels.

name: liquid-breadcrumbs
title: LiquidBreadcrumbs
description: A trail of links with glyph separators and a current-page marker.

name: liquid-button
title: LiquidButton
description: The primary action control: WebGL rim light, jelly press spring and a loading state.

name: liquid-checkbox
title: LiquidCheckbox
description: A checkbox with a springy tick, indeterminate state and label support.

name: liquid-chip
title: LiquidChip
description: A compact tag that can be selected, tinted and dismissed.

name: liquid-date-picker
title: LiquidDatePicker
description: A calendar popover on a field trigger: a roving-tabindex month grid and ISO values.

name: liquid-dialog
title: LiquidDialog
description: A modal on Base UI: trapped focus, inert background and wired-up title and description.

name: liquid-divider
title: LiquidDivider
description: A hairline rule, horizontal or vertical, with optional inline content.

name: liquid-drawer
title: LiquidDrawer
description: A side panel that slides from the left, right or bottom edge, on Base UI Dialog.

name: liquid-glass
title: LiquidGlass
description: The bare material with its optics as props: refraction, frost, veil and bezel.

name: liquid-icon-button
title: LiquidIconButton
description: A square icon-only button that takes its accessible name from a label prop.

name: liquid-list
title: LiquidList
description: A glass list with items, descriptions, leading icons, trailing slots and subheaders.

name: liquid-menu
title: LiquidMenu
description: A dropdown action menu on Base UI: arrow keys, typeahead and collision-aware placement.

name: liquid-pagination
title: LiquidPagination
description: A page strip with ellipsis truncation and previous/next controls.

name: liquid-progress
title: LiquidProgress
description: A determinate progress bar and an indeterminate spinner sharing one accent.

name: liquid-radio
title: LiquidRadioGroup
description: A radio group with a springy dot and keyboard-driven selection.

name: liquid-rating
title: LiquidRating
description: A star rating that reads and writes a numeric value.

name: liquid-segmented
title: LiquidSegmented
description: A segmented control whose glass indicator slides between options.

name: liquid-select
title: LiquidSelect
description: A listbox dropdown on Base UI: typeahead, focus return and a glass popover.

name: liquid-skeleton
title: LiquidSkeleton
description: A shimmering placeholder block for content that has not arrived.

name: liquid-slider
title: LiquidSlider
description: A range input with a luminous track and a dimensional thumb.

name: liquid-surface
title: LiquidSurface
description: The base material every glass component is built on: rim light, refraction and springs.

name: liquid-switch
title: LiquidSwitch
description: A toggle whose thumb squashes as it travels.

name: liquid-table
title: LiquidTableContainer
description: A composable data table on a glass container, with row hover and selection.

name: liquid-tabs
title: LiquidTabs
description: Composable tabs on Base UI, with a glowing underline that springs between them.

name: liquid-text-field
title: LiquidTextField
description: A single-line text input with label, hint and invalid state.

name: liquid-textarea
title: LiquidTextArea
description: A multi-line text input that keeps the field styling of LiquidTextField.

name: liquid-toast
title: LiquidToastProvider
description: A toast provider and a useLiquidToast hook for transient messages.

name: liquid-tooltip
title: LiquidTooltip
description: A glass bubble on hover and focus, positioned by Base UI so it stays on screen.
